wasm_clippy.command: cargo +1.99.0 clippy --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -p esp32sim-wasm --features jit-tests -- -D warnings

wasm_tests.command: node tools/wasm-test.mjs hello c3-hello c6-hello c6-energy-scan c6-contiki c6-contiki-net c6-rpl-net panel

jit: No JIT source changes; separate differential suite not required.
test_inputs: CI ROM path was the absolute worktree web/wasm/fw directory. No external firmware variables supplied. All external_ tests retain input-specific ignores.
privacy: New evidence contains only code, source/binary/disassembly hashes, commands and numeric results. No process inventories, host identity or private captures retained.
